verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's CLI is fully non-interactive/keyless and scriptable (headless plan→apply→destroy verified in probes), which is a prerequisite for wiring it into cron jobs or CI/CD pipelines for autonomous runs, but there is no evidence of any built-in scheduler, trigger, webhook, or agent runtime that autonomously initiates or manages background runs on its own. missing for 10: native scheduling/trigger mechanism, evidence of autonomous (not just headless) background operation, first-party automation/orchestration features beyond CLI scriptability.
